# Medway & Kent Removals

> Professional, fully insured removal company based in Rochester, Kent, England. House removals, office relocations, packing services, man and van, single item pickups and secure storage across Medway and the whole of Kent. Fixed price quotes with no hidden charges, rated 5 stars from 50+ Google reviews, and we respond to every enquiry within 60 minutes.

Company facts:
- Business name: Medway & Kent Removals
- Based: Knight Templar Way, Rochester, Kent, ME2 2ZE, United Kingdom
- Phone: 01634 971005 (office), 07359 917380 (mobile and WhatsApp)
- Email: info@medwaykentremovals.co.uk
- Open 7 days a week
- Fully insured: goods in transit insurance (full replacement value) plus public liability insurance on every move
- Reviews: 5 stars from 50+ Google reviews
- Booking terms: 10% deposit secures the date, remaining 90% payable on the move date
- Quotes are fixed price, itemised and valid for 14 days

Areas covered: Rochester, Chatham, Gillingham, Strood, Rainham, Hoo, Cliffe, Walderslade, Lordswood, Hempstead, Maidstone, Gravesend, Dartford, Sittingbourne, Faversham, Canterbury, Whitstable, Herne Bay, Margate, Ramsgate, Deal, Dover, Folkestone, Ashford, Tonbridge, Tunbridge Wells, Sevenoaks and all of Kent, plus long distance moves anywhere in the UK.

## Services

- [House removals](https://www.medwaykentremovals.co.uk/house-removals): full home moves of any size, door to door
- [Office removals](https://www.medwaykentremovals.co.uk/office-removals): business and commercial relocations
- [Packing services](https://www.medwaykentremovals.co.uk/packing-services): full or partial packing with materials supplied
- [Man and van](https://www.medwaykentremovals.co.uk/man-and-van): smaller moves, single items, eBay collections, student moves
- [Storage](https://www.medwaykentremovals.co.uk/storage): secure short and long term storage
- [Long distance removals](https://www.medwaykentremovals.co.uk/long-distance-removals): Kent to anywhere in the UK

## Pricing

- [Pricing guide (machine readable)](https://www.medwaykentremovals.co.uk/pricing.md): current price bands by property size
- Typical local 2 bedroom move within Medway: from £350 to £550
- Typical 3 bedroom move: from £550 to £850
- 4 and 5 bedroom moves: from £900 upwards
- Long distance moves priced individually by destination
- Every quote is fixed price with no hidden charges
